answer_1.quote: Long-form question answering (LFQA) presents a unique challenge in natural language processing (NLP), demanding models that not only comprehend the long context but also maintain factual accuracy during answer generation ... This paper introduces TAPERA, aiming to enhance the trustworthiness of LLM-based methods in long-form TAble QA ... The task is to generate a paragraph-long answer Y = (y1, y2, . . . , yn) given the query Q and source table T.

answer_2.quote: Following QTSUMM, we adopt following popular automated evaluation metrics: • BLEU ... • ROUGE ... • METEOR ... • BERTScore ... • TAPAS-Acc ... • AutoACU ...

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation results demonstrate that TAPERA achieves significant improvements ... Each generated answer was scored from 1 (worst) to 5 (best) for each criteria, with the final score averaged across different evaluators.
answer_4.guideline: Assess each generated answer on two dimensions (Faithfulness and Comprehensiveness) using a Likert scale from 1 to 5.
